name: Travel Agency Package 2
definition: Provides detailed information about the travel package, excluding specific itinerary data.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Describes the type of travel offering provided by the travel agency or partner.

NumberInParty.name: Number In Party
NumberInParty.definition: Number of people included in the travel arrangements.

CustomerReference.name: Customer Reference
CustomerReference.definition: Contains Customer Reference Values provided for this transaction and used for various reference processing at the customer site. These values represent information most prevalently provided by travel agencies for transactions booked against a lodged account or central travel account.

DataSource.name: Data Source
DataSource.definition: Indicates the source of enhanced data that is matched to the transaction.

DeliveryOrderNumber.name: Delivery Order Number
DeliveryOrderNumber.definition: Contains a customer invoice number for a rail sale to a corporate account.

CreditCardSlipNumber.name: Credit Card Slip Number
CreditCardSlipNumber.definition: Contains a slip number from the credit card slip.

Insurance.name: Insurance
Insurance.definition: Indicates whether or not insurance was purchased.
